scores.rationale: The candidate's implementation is functionally identical to the reference, accurately accumulating usage across all tool rounds while ignoring unreported rounds and preserving undefined when no rounds report usage. It meets every acceptance criterion, including testing a turn with two tool rounds (three provider calls), leaving the existing no-tool test untouched, and updating the changelog and hooks spec. For the requirement to make the type unambiguous in the signature, the candidate introduced a backwards-compatible `AggregatedUsageMetadata` type alias on `usage?: AggregatedUsageMetadata`, whereas the reference renamed the parameter to `totalUsage?: UsageMetadata` and also updated `CLAUDE.md` and `specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md`. The candidate also placed the helper in `orchestratorHelpers.ts` and tests in new files rather than inline in `chatOrchestrator.ts` and `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`, and left thenew behaviour under the 'Measured semantics — out of scope' heading in `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` instead of moving it to the main spec section.
